_help: Fill in every value that still starts with '[' and rebuild: node build/build_deck.js && python3 build/postprocess.py. Names below were read from the end card of your demo video: please check the spelling.
_process_photos_help: Up to 3 image paths (relative to submission/), for example assets/team/working-1.jpg. Empty slots show a labelled placeholder.
_demo_video_help: Optional path to your demo video (mp4), for example assets/demo/lunarseye-demo.mp4. If set, slide 10 becomes the full-screen video.
